# Home Bartender
A personal cocktail recipe collection with filtering by spirit, method, difficulty, and flavor.

## Recipes
Full recipe list: https://dancj.github.io/home-bartender/

## Data
Machine-readable recipe collection (JSON): https://dancj.github.io/home-bartender/recipes.json

## Bar sharing
Pre-populate "My Bar" via ?bar=<slug>,<slug> (comma-separated spirit slugs from recipes.json's "spirits" field) appended to the recipe list URL. Example: https://dancj.github.io/home-bartender/?bar=mezcal,bourbon
